title: Suppress Overview Slide Jump After Drag
description: In projektetage presentation, Escape opens reveal overview. Dragging dispositions in overview then releasing jumps to that slide; should only navigate when clicking empty slide space, not after drag/marquee.
summary: Fixed reveal overview exiting when releasing a disposition drag or marquee. After a gesture crosses the drag threshold, a one-shot capture click handler on `.reveal` prevents reveal.js `onSlideClicked` from running; empty-space clicks still navigate. Added unit test; all 97 presentation renderer tests pass.
